classification_rationale: Modifies partition table rereading and locking in systemd storage daemons and udev/sd-device
Fixes mount namespace setup in core/exec-invoke.c and execute-serialize.c
Fixes image dissection and namespace dm-verity reuse in src/shared/dissect-image.c and src/core/namespace.c
Modifies service reload lifecycle and dbus-service state transitions in src/core/
Fixes certificate chain validation logic in HUKS security service (hks_verifier.c)
Modifies ArkUI shape extraction across arkts bridge and native visual_effect modules
Fixes display composer and render_service pipeline handling during multi-screen transitions
The pcrlock utility fails to read the virtual TPM log in the Hyper-V Azure environment. The linked commit changes pcrlock.c.
The systemd status path fails under WSL. The linked patch series changes cgroup handling in the manager and supporting code.
The report gives reconfiguration as the trigger. The fix changes ordering but the report does not establish a race. The original paper uses Concurrency/Multi-thread.
Journal reader library hangs on corrupted journal input. The fix is in sd-journal/journal-file.c.
The udev worker loses watches after a child script timeout. The fix changes worker timeout handling in udev-manager.c.
The PID 1 unit manager fails to emit a notification during a freeze or thaw transition. The diff changes unit and cgroup management.
The sysupdate utility mishandles incomplete versions during an update. The dominant change is in sysupdate state handling.
The user-facing journalctl completion returns the wrong units for a normal command option. The patch is in its shell completion.
The logind service aborts in the reported swap configuration. Available evidence does not resolve whether external environment or an exceptional runtime state is decisive.
